name: EnhancedJobParser
description: Extracts comprehensive fields from job postings, designed to capture detailed information including salary breakdowns, employment types, and more.

markdown_body.description: The full job description in [[markdown]] format.
examples: - Develop cutting-edge software solutions. - Responsibilities include coding, testing, and deploying applications.

location.description: The geographical location of the job, including city and country.

min.description: The minimum salary offered for the job.

max.description: The maximum salary offered for the job.

currency.description: The currency of the salary (e.g., USD, EUR).

frequency.description: The frequency of salary payment (e.g., hourly, monthly, annually).

salary.description: The detailed salary information for the job.

type.description: The type of employment (e.g., full-time, part-time, contract, temporary).

minYears.description: The minimum years of experience required for the job.

maxYears.description: The maximum years of experience required for the job.

level.description: The experience level (e.g., entry-level, mid-level, senior, director).

experienceLevel.description: The experience level required for the job.

qualifications.description: List of all qualifications, Certifications required or preferred, extracted using contextual clues in [[markdown]] format.
examples: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science - 5+ years in large scale big data engineering experience

skills.description: List of professional and technical skills required for the job.

postedDate.description: The date when the job was posted.

applicationDeadline.description: The application deadline for the job if present or ''.

name.description: The name of the company offering the job.

industry.description: The industry sector the company operates in.

size.description: The size of the company (e.g., 1-10 employees, 11-50 employees).

description.description: A brief overview of the company.

logoUrl.description: The URL of the company's logo image.

company.description: Detailed information about the company offering the job.

applicationLink.description: A direct link to the job application or company's career page.

tags.description: Keywords or tags associated with the job for searching and filtering purposes.

benefits.description: List of benefits offered with the job (e.g., health insurance, paid time off).

workEnvironment.description: Description of the work environment (e.g., remote, in-office, hybrid).

examples.title: Software Engineer
examples.markdown_body: - Develop cutting-edge software solutions. - Responsibilities include coding, testing, and deploying applications.
examples.qualifications: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science - 5+ years in large scale big data engineering experience

company.name: Tech Innovations Inc.
company.description: A leading provider of innovative software solutions.
